title: Meta-Integrity: A System That Verifies Itself
summary: Today we published our first official verifiable communication. The message proves itself. The system validates its own communication.
body:
Today we published our first official verifiable communication.

W-COMM-001 is fully live.

But here is the real breakthrough:

This communication is not just published.
It is cryptographically verifiable — by the very system it describes.

That means:

→ The message proves itself
→ The system validates its own communication
→ Integrity is no longer claimed — it is demonstrated

This is what we call meta-integrity:

A system that does not ask for trust —
but allows anyone to verify the truth independently.

We are entering a world where:

– Content can be generated infinitely
– Authenticity becomes the scarce resource

WINDI introduces a simple principle:

"Don't trust the message — verify it."

This is not a feature.

It is a new standard for institutional communication.
